evidence.quote: The Alchesay National Fish Hatchery serves as a "grow-out rearing unit" for 3-to-6-inch (7.6 to 15.2 cm) brown trout (Salmo trutta) and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) fingerlings transferred to it from the Williams Creek National Fish Hatchery.

evidence.claim: Its name honors Alchesay, a White Mountain Apache chief and U.S. Army scout who received the Medal of Honor.
